I wrote the review for Q11–20 to `docs/evidence/fp2-2026-may-practical/solutions-batch-02.json`, and all 10 records are approved.

- **Records:** 10
- **Approved:** 10
- **Held:** 0
- **Output file:** `docs/evidence/fp2-2026-may-practical/solutions-batch-02.json`

**Answers:** All 10 official answers match the answer PDF. The PDF's text layer is missing the answers for Q13 and Q20, so I read those two from a rendered image of the page: Q13 (ア)19 (イ)572 (ウ)5,220 and Q20 = 3. I recalculated every question from the question PDF's own figures and tables, and each one lands on the official answer. No answers were changed and no application code was touched.

**Extracted text:** Checked against the rendered pages, the text in `practical-2024-2025.json` is accurate. Table layouts are flattened, but no values are missing, so `figureIssue` and `textIssue` are null for all 10. Two questions run over a page break (Q13 on pp.8–9, Q16's answer choices on p.13), and in each case `sourcePage` records the first page.

**Government references:** I only listed pages I actually opened: NTA tax-answer pages 1140, 1141, 1250, 1420, 1600, 1605 and joto/3258; Corporation Tax Basic Circular 9-3-4 on nta.go.jp; and the Ministry of Finance earthquake-insurance page. Q11 and Q13 have none.

**Q14 caveat:** I approved Q14, but one of the rules behind it isn't backed by a checked government source. The answer 117,000 only works if the auto-renewing one-year contract (①) counts as a post-2012 "new" contract. That is standard FP treatment and the official answer confirms it, but NTA pages 1140 and 1141 don't state it explicitly, and I couldn't extract text from the NTA year-end adjustment PDF. The same applies to counting the 30,000 yen paid by automatic premium loan as premiums paid. If you want every rule tied to a checked government page, change Q14 to held.
